name: Silo Dark
why_visit: Seed-vault wrecks in a night gyre. The orchard stock is still in the dark, and an ambush keeps it.

bodies.name: Night Vault
bodies.blurb: The dark silo. The vault door is open and the lights are not.
bodies.legal: A seed vault that lost its lights. The stock is in the wrecks. The pocket is not a claim.
bodies.ruins: The vault log, last line a power cut.

bodies.name: Orchard Dark
bodies.blurb: A dark orchard. The rows are still marked.
bodies.legal: The night orchard moon. Nothing grows until a lamp is brought.
bodies.ruins: A lamp post with no lamp.

belt.name: Seed Hulls
belt.composition: split seed cases and vault bolts shaken out of the night silo
belt.legal: Seed hulls from the vault. Amber law. The ambush thinks they are paid.

trash.name: Opened Silos
trash.origin: Seed vaults cracked in the dark and left spinning when the power cut.
trash.legal: Opened silos. Salvage is there. So is the ambush.

pocket.name: Dark Pocket
pocket.why: The vault pocket is dark. It is not on the claim slate.

duties: Ambush over Silo Dark. Hold the vault buoy. Close when a keel enters 520 meters.
Raider over Silo Dark. Take the vault clerk's hull. The seed cases are the second cut.

haulers.name: Vault Clerk
haulers.duty: Vault Clerk at Silo Dark. Come alongside and the clerk names which silo still has a case.
